items.headline: Canadian Poet Anne Carson Wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
items.summary: Canadian poet and essayist Anne Carson was awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature on Thursday for her inventive work blending classical traditions with modern forms. The Swedish Academy praised her unique genre-crossing style, making her only the second Canadian author to receive the prestigious honor.

items.headline: U.S. Awards Top Science Medals to Tech CEOs as Companies Pledge $2.4 Billion for AI
items.summary: On October 8, U.S. President Donald Trump presented the National Medal of Science and National Medal of Technology to major tech leaders, including Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, and Satya Nadella. Alongside the awards, leading technology companies committed $2.4 billion in artificial intelligence computing resources to support government-backed scientific research through the Genesis Mission.

items.headline: Major League Baseball Proposes Shortening Regular Season to 154 Games
items.summary: During collective bargaining negotiations on Thursday, Major League Baseball proposed reducing the regular season from 162 to 154 games starting in 2029 while expanding the Division Series to a best-of-seven format. The proposal also suggests allowing top playoff seeds to choose their postseason opponents to better prioritize player rest and broadcast schedules.
